amount.description: Transaction amount (optional, in whatever currency applies)

currency.description: Currency code (optional, e.g. USD, EUR, BTC)

description.description: Description of the service or product transacted

transactionId.description: Unique identifier for this transaction, must be identical in both parties' records

serviceConsumer.description: DID of the service consumer identity

serviceProvider.description: DID of the service provider identity

main.description: A verified transaction between two ATProto identities that must be stored in both parties' PDS
